scientific_question: Using identical held-out months, how does the native nine-parameter Fourier model compare with the frozen cubic/cubic rational candidate and frozen cubic polynomial baseline on NIST ENSO?

dataset_scope.name: NIST/ITL StRD ENSO
dataset_scope.response: monthly averaged atmospheric pressure difference between Easter Island and Darwin, Australia

native_rule.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit method=lm,maxfev=200000,full_output=true; select lowest finite training RSS
native_rule.singular_rule: b4=0 or b7=0 returns non-finite predictions; no replacement by certified fits or post-hoc bounds
native_rule.failure_rule: Retain every failed start, non-finite RSS, non-finite prediction and failed fold; no post-hoc start, period bounds, scaling or fold changes
native_rule.retuning: No model, start, optimizer, period constraint, fold or threshold changes after seeing outcomes

known_answer_rule.purpose: Fit all 168 observations only to verify the native Fourier equation and optimizer against the NIST known answer; never use this fit as holdout evidence

fold_rule.construction: Inclusive integer month ranges identical to the frozen rational folds; fit native parameters only on the other four ranges

comparison_rule.join: Match native and rational predictions by fold and exact x; require observed y to match exactly
comparison_rule.rational_metrics: Reuse the frozen rational-candidate fold metrics and snapshot predictions without refitting
comparison_rule.cubic_baseline_metrics: Reuse the frozen cubic-baseline fold metrics without refitting; per-point baseline predictions are not available in the frozen result
comparison_rule.metrics: Recompute native RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual from held-out predictions in each fold
comparison_rule.fold_winners: Compare native RMSE with rational and cubic-baseline RMSE separately; preserve wins, losses, ties and failed fits without a single scalar ranking
comparison_rule.pooled_metrics: Compute native and rational RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual over all 168 held-out predictions only when every fold succeeds; do not fabricate pooled cubic-baseline metrics
comparison_rule.parameter_stability: Report minimum, median, maximum and range for all nine parameters, especially b4 and b7, without converting fold variation into a probability distribution
comparison_rule.bound_separation: Do not transfer rational denominator, ellipsoid, box, residual-bound or continuous-safety claims to the native Fourier model

prohibitions: No use of the certified full-data fit as a held-out prediction
No transfer of rational-model proof regions or residual bounds to the native Fourier model
No hiding of optimizer failures, non-finite predictions, fold-level losses or period variation
No probability, confidence, physical-endogeneity, absolute-ranking or independent-experiment claim
No post-hoc start, period constraint, fold, scaling or model changes after seeing results
